test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 1 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

A lot of people are seen gathering, __discussing and negotiating__ in front of our stall in the town.
solution: The correct answer is "**bargaining**". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence talks about people gathering in front of a stall in town and "**discussing and negotiating**". • The word "**discussing and negotiating**" implies that **people are trying to come to a mutually beneficial agreement on a matter of interest**. • The word "**bargaining**" is the best substitute for "**discussing and negotiating**" as it means to **negotiate the terms and conditions of a transaction or agreement**. • ​Thus, ***option 3*** is the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** __ • **Deal: **take part in commercial trading of a particular commodity. • **Jostle: **struggle or compete forcefully for. • **Collect**: bring or gather together (things, typically when scattered or widespread). [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** • **Bargain**: लेनदेन या समझौते के नियमों और शर्तों पर बातचीत करना। • Deal: किसी विशेष वस्तु के वाणिज्यिक व्यापार में भाग लेना। • Jostle: संघर्ष करना या इसके लिए बलपूर्वक प्रतिस्पर्धा करना। • Collect: एक साथ लाना या इकट्ठा करना। 9d:T11f7, The correct answer is "**flicker**"
